title: CopilotKit/OpenIntelligentUI
friendlyTitle: OpenIntelligentUI helps AI create interactive screens
summary: An open-source generative UI framework for streaming interactive widgets, charts and sandboxed interfaces from an agent, with export and MCP integration options.
friendlySummary: This framework lets an AI agent return charts, forms and small interactive tools instead of only text.
whyItMatters: Developers can study or reuse its patterns when a chat response needs to become an interactive interface rather than plain text. The repository includes a web app, agent backend, design system and deployment documentation.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a starting point when building an AI app that needs useful controls and visual results inside the conversation.
